verdict.rationale: First-party Graph docs show users can flag a message for follow-up, which is Outlook's own follow-up mechanism and partly covers the story. Nothing in the pack documents snoozing conversations, reminder timing, or a thread resurfacing automatically when nobody replies. missing for 10: snooze conversations capability, timed follow-up reminders, automatic resurfacing of threads with no reply, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies

citations.quote: app users can change the importance of a message (or event or task), or flag a message for follow-up
